message:
feat(desktop): retention sweep spares recordings referenced by saved projects (#132) (#137)

- pruneRecordings takes a keepNames set; collectReferencedRecordingNames scans recent projects' sourceAudio.originalPath and protects names inside the recordings dir (case/slash-insensitive prefix match, sibling dirs excluded, unreadable projects fail open)

- App.tsx wires the collector before the startup prune
